summary:
Conclusion: the fix is correct, and nothing in it blocks shipping. I found no must and no defect a player would see. Every item in the brief is gone on the fixed tree. I tested with real production play: a production tab on f2c93f1 shared one localStorage with the new build, and I offered a real gift in production's gift box. Each original defect reproduced on the base 6d03faf before I tested the fix. All new player-facing lines keep the hard lines, and the font check says stale: none.

The weaknesses are all in the tests:
- **should:** Nothing tests the negative half of the main fix: a 'gift' slot that is not done (n 0) must not count. This is the most common shape of a real production save. If the rule is mutated to count any gift slot, the full Q scenario still passes 71/0.
- **nit:** The new X check that claims "a late write from a closed tab is still ignored inside the 1 s window" checks nothing. It sends `window.__xpre`, which is undefined because the page was reloaded earlier. The guard is still covered by the older im3 check. That older check now depends on two evaluate calls landing within 1 s of each other; I measured 222 ms at load 1.9.
- **nit:** Two smaller parts of item 2 have no check: the dedupe of `keptIds`, and `weekDoneN` reading `keptIds` instead of the `kept` number. Both only matter for test-build or hand-edited saves.
- **nit:** One thing I saw that this change did not cause: when the new tab repairs a slot that the old tab re-dealt, it resets that slot's reroll count, so an old-build tab can deal 'days' on that slot without end. The points stay correct.

Results by item:
- **C1 = S1 = V1 (gift point):** On base, a production week at 5/5 drops to 4/5 with no claim button. On the next Monday base pays nothing (only the day gift, 26 shells). On the fix, the same week shows 5/5 with the claim button, the dot and the line `목록에서 빠진 일도 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어.`, with keptIds [gift]. Claiming pays 12 shells and 2 seeds. On Monday the fix pays once (23 to 38 shells), shows the toast `지난주 선물은…` once, and a reload does not pay again. With both removed tasks done, the week counts 5/5 from three real tasks plus the two removed ones.
- **S2 (counting twice), two real tabs:** On base, kept climbs 1, 2, 3, 4 and the sheet shows 5/5 with only three tasks really done. On the fix, kept stays at one for 'days'. It becomes two only after a gift is really offered in the old tab, and stays two when 'days' is dealt again.
- **C2 (import guard):** Base drops the other tab's reset and the octopus named after it. The fix follows both, and the late-write guard still holds.
- **C3 (salon colour):** Base reloads to #4a86d8; the fix keeps #4fa868, the same as production.
- **C4 (early save in import):** Base writes twice during an import, the first with a lastSeen 3 days ahead. The fix writes once, already clipped.
- **C5 (wording):** A week three weeks back now says `전에 안 받은 주간 선물은…`. The week just before still says `지난주`, and so does a stored prev without `from`.
- **S4 (reset):** Base keeps the old octopus's rest after a reset (rest {trip_b7np, left 597322}). The fix clears it.
- **P4 (midnight):** Base keeps yesterday's rows in `오늘의 산책` after the new day's gift arrives. The fix switches them together with the gift.
- **V2 (harvest toast):** An unknown colour now says `꽃을 거뒀어`. A known one still says `초록 염료 1개를 얻었어`.
- **V3/P6 (claim button at 320x568):** The button is fully visible on open in 3D and 2D, in both fonts, and in dark mode with reduced motion. Only the 320x568 pixel-font case scrolls the sheet, by 32 px. The page behind never scrolls, and 360x740 and 390x844 do not move.

Lane check: no owner3 function was touched. owner3's patch applies cleanly on top of this diff, and their RO-1 check (`kept === 1`) stays consistent with the new code. I did not run the merged tree.

Suites on a /dev/shm copy:
- `npm test`: exit 0.
- Font check: stale: none.
- Full Q: 71/0.
- Q section 23 alone: 38/0 five times in a row (load 7 to 12).
- X: 51/0 twice, and once more with my instrumentation.
- A: 74/0.
- Y: 99/0 on a clean fix copy, and 99/0 twice on the base. Y crashed 4 times out of 4 at smoke.js:2591 in my working copy (extra hooks), including once with the base's app.js and salon.js put back. So the crash is not from the product change. I could not explain why only that copy crashed.

The fix tree is untouched. My copies in /dev/shm are deleted and the server is stopped. Probes, logs and screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-v2/.

problems.title: No check guards that a not-done 'gift' slot (n 0) does not count
problems.where: js/app.js:4380 (GONE.gift: `(x.n | 0) >= 1`); tools/smoke.js Q section 23 (qGone, 5276+) and Q section 13 (5061)
problems.what: The must's rule has two halves: a done gift slot keeps its point (tested by 23-1 and 23-2), and an undone one does not count. Nothing tests the second half. Every gift slot seeded anywhere in Q has n 1. An undone 'gift' slot is the most common shape in real production saves: production dealt the task to about half of all names, and few players will have done it yet. If someone changes the threshold, every such player silently gets a free point, and no test fails.
problems.evidence: Mutant MD changes `>= 1` to `>= 0` in GONE.gift. Q section 23 alone still passes 38/0, and the full Q scenario passes 71/0 (check-v2/runs/MD-gift-any-n.log and MD-gift-any-n-fullQ.log). The current code behaves correctly: in my seeded probe case h, a week with gift n 0 and four done tasks shows (4/5), with no keptIds and no claim button (check-v2/p3-fix.log).
problems.suggested_fix: In qGone, add a case seeded with a production week that has {id:'gift', n:0} plus four done tasks. Expect (4/5), no keptIds, no claim button and no dot. On the next Monday, expect no week.prev and only the day gift. That makes mutant MD fail.

problems.title: The new X check's 'late write ignored inside the window' half tests nothing; the older check it relies on now depends on timing
problems.where: tools/smoke.js:6018 (new C4/C6/C2 step dispatches window.__xpre); window.__xpre is set at 5965 and wiped by pa.reload() at 5997; older gnits check im3 at 5968-5975
problems.what: window.__xpre was captured before the reload at line 5997, so in the new step it is undefined. The StorageEvent then has no newValue, and the listener returns at `!e.newValue`. The assertion `g1.late.name === '뚜루' && g1.late.shells === 21` therefore holds whatever the guard does. The guard inside the window is still covered by the older im3 check, which fails when the guard is turned off. But with the 1 s window, im3 now passes only if the next evaluate call starts within 1 s of the import that ran in the previous call. That is a speed-dependent check.
problems.evidence: In my instrumented X run, g1 shows xpreType 'undefined', and the gap from im2 to im3 was 222 ms at load 1.9 (check-v2/runs/X-instr.log). Mutant MF0 (IMPORT_HOLD = 0) passes the new check and fails only the old one, '불러오기 전에 쓰인 다른 탭 기록이 늦게 와도…' (check-v2/runs/MF0-hold-zero.log).
problems.suggested_fix: In the new step, read the stale record again after the reload, or pass it in as an argument, and assert that it is really dropped. In im2, dispatch the stale record in the same evaluate call as the import, so the check no longer depends on how quickly two round trips run.

problems.title: Two parts of item 2 have no failing check: keptIds dedupe, and weekDoneN reading keptIds instead of the kept number
problems.where: js/app.js:4386 (keptOf: filter with `a.indexOf(id) === i`); js/app.js:4423 (weekDoneN uses keptOf(w).length)
problems.what: No check fails if the dedupe is removed, or if weekDoneN goes back to `(w.kept | 0)`. Both only differ for saves whose kept number disagrees with keptIds while no repair is pending, or whose keptIds holds duplicates. Only test builds and hand edits write such saves.
problems.evidence: Mutants MB and MC both pass Q section 23 at 38/0 (check-v2/runs/MB-donen-number.log, MC-no-dedupe.log). My seeded probes show the correct behaviour: case c (keptIds wins over kept 5), case e (duplicate and unknown ids collapse to 2) and case g (legacy kept 2 is read as days once, 4/5) (check-v2/p3-fix.log).
problems.suggested_fix: Optional. Add one seeded week with keptIds ['days','days'] and kept 3 with no repair pending, and expect (4/5) with three real tasks done.

problems.title: Seen, not from this change: the new tab's repair gives a re-dealt slot its rerolls back, so an old-build tab can deal 'days' there forever
problems.where: js/app.js:4396 (same-week repair writes `{ id, n: 0, rr: 0 }`)
problems.what: An old-build tab taps 바꾸기 and gets 'days'. The new tab replaces that slot with a fresh task at rr 0. The old tab's next 바꾸기 on that slot deals 'days' again, because weekPick is deterministic for that rr, so its 바꾸기 count never runs out. Points are now counted correctly (once). 6d03faf behaves the same, and the S2 skeptic already noted it.
problems.evidence: check-v2/p2-fix.log: slot 3 goes furn, days, furn, days … through repeated taps in the production tab.
problems.suggested_fix: Optional. When replacing a slot that holds a removed task, keep its rr (`rr: x.rr | 0`), so the old tab's rerolls run out.

per_fix:
Item: reproduced on base 6d03faf → gone on fixed tree → check that fails when the fix is reverted

- C1 = S1 = V1 (done gift slot loses its point):
  - Base: yes, with a real production gift-box offer, then the update. Same week: (4/5), no claim, no dot. Monday: shells 26 (day gift only), no prev (p1-base-*.log).
  - Fix: gone. Same week: (5/5), claim, dot, kept line, keptIds [gift]. Claim pays 12 shells and 2 seeds. Monday: 23 to 38 once, '지난주' toast once, no double after reload. Both removed tasks done: (5/5) from 3 real tasks plus 2 (p1-fix-*.log).
  - Check: Q 23-1 (agent M1 fails 3 checks; M12 covers the kept line). The not-done half has no check (T1).
- S2 (same removed task counted twice):
  - Base: yes, with a real production tab plus a base tab. kept goes 2, then 3, then 4; (5/5) with 3 real tasks done (p2-base.log).
  - Fix: gone. keptIds [days] stays at one through re-deals. It becomes [days, gift] only after a real gift offer in the old tab (5 real), and stays two (p2-fix.log). The week change with a re-dealt days slot and 3 real tasks pays nothing (p3 case a).
  - Check: Q 23-2 and 23-2b (agent M2; my MA fails 23-2b). The dedupe and the weekDoneN read have no check (T3).
- C2 (import guard lasts forever):
  - Base: yes. The tab drops the other tab's reset and the octopus named after it, then writes 불러온문어 back (c2/shared-clock.log).
  - Fix: gone. It follows the reset and keeps 새문어. A late write inside the window is still dropped (c2/late-write.log).
  - Check: the X C2 step (agent M3) and the older im3 check (my MF0). The new check's late-write half is vacuous (T2).
- C3 (salon colour after the clock went back):
  - Base: yes, #4a86d8.
  - Fix: gone, #4fa868, the same as production (v2c/p3.log).
  - Check: the new test-salon check (I reverted only salon.js: 234/1).
- C4 (import saves before its checks):
  - Base: yes, 2 writes, the first 259199551 ms ahead.
  - Fix: gone, 1 write, already clipped (v2c/p4-*.log).
  - Check: the X C4 check (agent M4).
- C5 ('지난주' for older weeks):
  - Base: read from the code only (fixed strings); not run.
  - Fix: gone. Three weeks back gives '전에 안 받은…' in the toast and the line. The week just before and a prev without 'from' keep '지난주' (p3 f, f2, f3).
  - Check: Q 23-3 and Q3 r4 (agent M8).
- C6 (record parsed twice): read only. Check: the X parse-count check (agent M5).
- S4 (rest left in memory after reset):
  - Base: yes, after a real walk. rest {trip_b7np, left 597322} survives the reset and the new name.
  - Fix: gone, rest null (p5-s4-*.log).
  - Check: Q 23-5 (agent M9).
- P4 (yesterday's rows past midnight):
  - Base: yes. Yesterday's rows stay after the new day's gift.
  - Fix: gone. The rows change with the gift and match a reload (p8 run).
  - Check: Q 23-6 (agent M10).
- V2 (harvest toast for an unknown colour):
  - Base: from the reports; not re-run.
  - Fix: gone. Teal says '꽃을 거뒀어'; green says '초록 염료 1개를 얻었어'. Both dye keys are saved (p5-fix.log).
  - Check: the X toast check (agent M6).
- V3/P6 (claim button half off screen at 320x568):
  - Base: from the reports and the agent's 'before' shots; not re-run.
  - Fix: gone. At 320x568 pixel font, the button sits at 483-559 of 568, the sheet scrolls 32 px and the page scrollY stays 0. The plain font, 360x740, 390x844, dark mode with reduced motion, and 2D are all fully visible, and only the pixel-font 320 case scrolls.
  - Check: Q 23-4 (agent M7).
mutations:
My own mutants, each applied alone in a /dev/shm copy. The Q runs used a temporary hook that runs Q's early sections and section 23 only.
- MA: the week-change `due` goes back to the old formula `weekOk ? questDone : oldDone` + `(w.kept|0)`. Q23 37/1: '지난주 정말 한 일 셋 + 뺀 일 «사흘 들어오기» 하나 … 월요일에 주간 선물 없음' fails (shells 20 → 35).
- MB: weekDoneN reads `(w.kept|0)` instead of keptOf. Q23 38/0, SURVIVES.
- MC: keptOf without the dedupe. Q23 38/0, SURVIVES.
- MD: GONE.gift `>= 0`, so any gift slot counts. Q23 38/0, and the full Q scenario 71/0: SURVIVES (finding T1).
- MF0: IMPORT_HOLD = 0, so the guard is never on. X 50/1: only the older gnits check fails ('불러오기 전에 쓰인 다른 탭 기록이 늦게 와도 불러온 기록 그대로'). The new C2/C6 late-write assertion still passes (finding T2).
- C3 revert (base salon.js with the fix's test-salon.js): test-salon 234/1, the new 'a dye asked after the clock went back …' check fails.

The agent's own mutation table (M1 to M12): I read the logs in fix-v2/mut/. Each one has the FAIL lines the report quotes. I did not re-run them, apart from C3 (confirmed) and MF0, which is close to their M3.
suites: npm test on a /dev/shm copy of the fixed tree: exit 0 (brain 517/0, model-voice 26/0, runner 568/0, api 225/0, cook 192/0, salon 235/0, export 46/0, plus the other tests).
Q section 23 alone (temporary hook in my copy): 38/0 five times in a row, at loads 7.2, 10.4, 10.4, 10.1 and 11.7.
SMOKE_ONLY=X: 51/0 at load 10.9 and 51/0 at load 7.1, plus an instrumented run 51/0 at load 1.9. With the agent's three runs, X has passed five times on this code.

SMOKE_ONLY=Y: the clean fixed copy passes 99/0 (load 1.85). The untouched 6d03faf copy passes 99/0 twice (control). My working copy, which had extra hooks in the Q and X sections only, crashed 4 times out of 4 at smoke.js:2591: waitForSelector('dialog[open] #look-close') timed out even though the button had already been found visible. It crashed the same way with the base's app.js and salon.js put back, so the crash does not come from the product change. The agent saw the same crash on the fix twice (#set-close) and on the base once (#al-close). This is a flaky 5 s wait in Y's sheet loop, and I give no verdict against the fix.
Load note: load average was 2 to 12 during my runs, while lane owner3 ran browsers on another tree. I ran one browser at a time.
held: Item 1, the gift point, holds with real production play, not a simulation. I offered a gift in f2c93f1's gift box in a production tab, then opened the new build in the same tab and origin. Same week: 5/5, claim, dot and kept line. Claiming pays 12 shells and 2 seeds. Next Monday it pays once, the toast shows once, and a reload does not pay again. 'days' and 'gift' done together count as two.

Item 2 holds with two real tabs (production f2c93f1 and the fixed build). Re-dealing 'days' in the production tab never adds a point. A gift really offered in the old tab adds exactly one, and dealing it again adds nothing. This held through a reload.

Damaged and legacy week fields, all seeded at the week change or in the same week: a plain kept number with no keptIds is read as 'days' once; keptIds wins over an inflated kept; a keptIds that is not an array falls back to the kept number; duplicate, unknown and '__proto__' ids are dropped; a damaged q with null or string slots, a missing n or n given as text does not crash; a claimed week shows no button; a gift slot at n 5 counts once. No page errors.
The C2 window is not used up by importJSON itself: importJSON takes 5 to 9 ms in total, and only about 1 ms of it runs after importAt (p6-import-time.log).

No check got weaker. `git diff 6d03faf -- tools/` changes only the expected texts in Q21 (KEPT line), Q3 r4 (now stricter, an exact new line) and X (the toast). It adds Q section 23 and a new X step, and removes no ok() check.

Hard lines on every new player line ('목록에서 빠진 일도 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어.', '전에 안 받은 주간 선물은 살림에 넣어 뒀어…', '꽃을 거뒀어'): plain Korean, nothing about what the octopus feels, no symbols, no pressure, and the font check says stale: none. Nothing touches sound.

Lanes: restDown, finalPose, syncRest, sleepNow, on.octUp, scenario Z and owner3's Q21 checks are untouched. owner3's patch (`git diff` of /home/user/ppolppol-fix-owner) applies cleanly on 6d03faf plus this diff, and both files pass `node --check`.

The 320x568 scroll moves only the sheet, never the page behind (scrollY 0). It is the same in 2D and with reduced motion, and no other size moves. Reopening the sheet keeps the same position, and the claim works with a tap.

P4 deliberately skips the 2-minute 'walk just ended' hold only at the moment the new day's gift arrives. Before the fix, those rows would have changed at most 2 minutes later anyway, so this is harmless.
not_checked: Running the merged tree with owner3's code (Q21 RO-1 and RO-2 together with section 23). I only applied their patch and ran a syntax check.
A real phone. I used headless Chromium with touch at DPR 2.
Re-running the base for C5, V2 and V3 myself. For these I relied on the code, the verification reports and the agent's 'before' shots.

A production tab left open across the Monday week change next to a new-build tab. Production would rebuild the week first and drop the unclaimed gift, which is the old W1 transition behaviour, not part of this lane.
Importing or exporting a save that carries keptIds, and importJSON leaving the rest countdown in place (S4 asked only about reset).
Smoke scenarios other than Q, X, A and Y; the scene perf test; intro-shots.

Why my working copy crashed Y 4 times out of 4 while the clean copies passed. Its only differences from the clean fix copy were extra lines inside the Q and X sections of smoke.js, and it crashed with the base's js as well.
